column4: Both ANSWERED; Badugi (b) "a full line with no two cards sharing a rank and no two sharing a suit" is the same meld as Cluster (c) "a line where no two cards share a rank or a suit"

Both ANSWERED; Bulwark (c) "any five cards that share no rank and no suit at all" and Cluster (c) "a line where no two cards share a rank or a suit" describe the same meld once the five cards are read as forming a line
